analysis.summary: For Q1 FY27, Krishana Phoschem Limited reported quarterly revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, a 35% year-on-year increase, and a PAT of ₹47 crore. The company achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, with NPK-DAP capacity utilization at 43% and SSP capacity utilization at 121%. Management highlighted raw material availability constraints and geopolitical tensions in West Asia as key operational headwinds during the quarter, but noted demand recovery following early July monsoon revival. Moving forward, the company expects to achieve quarterly revenues exceeding ₹500 crore over the remaining quarters of FY27. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported a 34.58% YoY increase in quarterly revenue to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% YoY increase in PAT to ₹47.06 crore for Q1 FY27.

guidance.claim: Krishana Phoschem expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover over the previous year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver over 40% growth across key parameters during the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: The company expects a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore from the newly expanded capacity.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore.

guidance.claim: Management targets overall revenue growth of 35%-40% in FY27 across manufacturing and trading.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to import around 150,000 metric tons of material in FY27, generating approximately Rs. 1,000 crore in revenue.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: National Kharif sowing declined by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares by the end of June due to rainfall deficit.
demand_outlook.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, driving a rapid recovery in sowing and fertilizer offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Peak Rabi season saw strong industry performance with P&K production reaching 15.76 lakh metric tonne.
demand_outlook.quote: This was reflected in strong industry performance with P&K production reaching 15.76 lakh metric tonne during the peak period, marking one of the highest monthly output levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Management believes domestic fertilizer manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

demand_outlook.claim: A favorable monsoon outlook and stable agricultural environment provide a constructive demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem added 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity, bringing total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating additional capacity expansion opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem signed an agreement to procure green ammonia from a third-party facility starting in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA are contributing to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, raising total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Sulphuric acid capacity was expanded to 99,000 MTPA to strengthen backward integration.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: Management has not planned any further capex additions beyond the recently completed projects.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stands at 7% to 8% for the trading business and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company passed on approximately 25% to 30% of raw material cost increases through subsidies and MRP revisions.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly revenue grew 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly revenue grew 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore, driven by sustained capacity utilization and efficient execution across our integrated value chain.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Global input costs firmed up from mid-February due to supply constraints, freight costs, and gas-linked production tightness.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 EBITDA reached Rs. 298 crore, registering a 62% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to Rs.298 crore, up 62% YoY, supported by improved operating performance, and a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: Overall EBITDA margin decreased from 13.54% in FY25 to 12.34% in FY26 due to higher trading activity.
margins_costs.quote: Our overall EBITDA margin, which was 13.54% has come down to 12.34%.

margins_costs.claim: The trading business generates an EBITDA margin of 5% to 6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is 5% to 6% in in trading business.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 margins to face pressure before stabilizing in later quarters.
margins_costs.quote: While there may be some margin pressure in the first quarter, we expect margins to stabilize in the later part of the year as cost increases are passed on.

orders_capacity.claim: Krishana Phoschem achieved total fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization in Q1 FY27 was 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Q1 FY27 sales volumes were 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP and 36,300 MT for SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: The company's installed capacity stands at 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT during Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production achieved for FY26 stood at 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants operated above rated capacity during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

orders_capacity.claim: FY26 manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons, while trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a 5-for-1 stock split, reducing the share face value from ₹10 to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Finance costs increased to ₹20 crore and depreciation increased to ₹13 crore following plant commissioning.
capital_allocation.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Disciplined capital allocation is one of the five core pillars of the company's strategic blueprint.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: The capacity expansion was funded using internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's effective borrowing interest cost ranges between 6% and 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

capital_allocation.claim: As of fiscal year end, subsidy receivables were about Rs. 400 crore and other receivables ranged between Rs. 300 crore and Rs. 325 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: So, subsidy receivable is almost Rs.400 crore and other receivables are in the range of Rs.300 crore to Rs.325 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material availability served as the main operational constraint during the first quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The primary challenge during the first quarter was the availability of raw materials.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices increased from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Shipping route disruptions caused elevated freight costs, vessel delays, and higher procurement expenses.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The domestic industry relies on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, making cost structures vulnerable to global movements.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties represent key monitorable risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets achieving an additional 30% to 35% revenue growth over the previous year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects quarterly revenue to exceed ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The green ammonia supply arrangement will commence in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company's new capacity expansion is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.
management_commitments.quote: As our Managing Director mentioned, our new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.

management_commitments.claim: Supply under the Green Ammonia Sale Agreement is expected to begin after approximately three years.
management_commitments.quote: As per the contract, the green ammonia plant is expected to commence operations in the third year, so we expect supply after approximately three years.

management_commitments.claim: Benefits of the expanded capacities are expected to meaningfully reflect in operational performance from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: Manufacturing volume growth is expected to be in the range of 25% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And based on the capacity utilization on a reasonable level, the growth in the manufacturing will be in the range of 25%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
